title: Hanse - Powder of Fortifying / Temperament
bodyHtml:
Hanse Replies to a question about Powder of Fortifying in UO Hall:

Powder of Temperament was changed to Powder of Fortifying. Powder of Fortifying, while only available through the BOD system, should affect all items that can be equipped and used in combat. This change is in publish 21.

[내구력을 올려주는 파우더가 퍼블21에서 전투시 장착해서 사용가능한 모든 아이템에 영향을 줄것입니다.]

Hanse
UO Live Designer
Ultima Online (www.uo.com)
Origin Systems
